about: Requests Uma might make, in Tamil, English and mixed, with what the assistant must and must not do. Run with: npm run eval (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; uses a throwaway eval.db). Seeded data: today's tasks 'Morning assembly' 08:30, 'Staff meeting' 11:00, 'Library visit' 14:00; contacts Mr. Raman (email), Priya Teacher and Priya Admin (emails), Teachers group and Parents group (WhatsApp groups); holiday 'Founders Day' 6 days ahead.
